summary: American Battery Materials Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing amendments to outstanding promissory and convertible notes. The maturity was extended to September 30, 2026. If the company fails to uplist its common stock to NYSE American by that date, principal will automatically increase by 15% ($1,459,217) to $11,187,330, and 612,476 shares of common stock will be issued to noteholders. The company states it is not in default. This is a debt restructuring with contingent equity issuance and penalty provisions tied to the uplist milestone. Watch for uplist progress as the September 30 deadline approaches.
